safetyBlock.description: Ensures machine is in known safe state at program start

toolChange.standard:
G28 G91 Z0          ; Return Z to home
M5                   ; Stop spindle
M9                   ; Coolant off
T{tool} M6           ; Tool change
G43 H{tool}          ; Apply length offset
S{rpm} M3            ; Start spindle
toolChange.siemens:
SUPA G0 Z=R11       ; Safe Z retract
M5                  ; Stop spindle
M9                  ; Coolant off
T{tool}             ; Prepare tool
M6                  ; Execute change
D{tool}             ; Activate offset
S{rpm} M3           ; Start spindle
